verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud file-storage and AI product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Poly-hosted services: web and desktop apps, a hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.poly.app, and a desktop app that syncs to Poly storage. Nothing documents deploying or running the core product on your own infrastructure, and the polymcp GitHub repo concerns MCP file-history access, not self-hosting the core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
